.epa-view-toggle {

}

.epa-dashboard button {

  color: #263b77;
  background: #f3f8ff;
  border: 1px solid #cbd9ed;
  border-radius: 999px;

  font-weight: 650;

}

.epa-dashboard button.active {
  color: #fff;

  border-color: #263b77;
}

.epa-dashboard button:not(.epa-legend-item):not(.active):hover {

}

.epa-year-filter input {
  width: min(180px, 30vw);
  accent-color: #2a9d8f;
}

.epa-dashboard-body {
  display: grid;

  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.epa-measure-menu {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  padding: 0.15rem 0;
}

.epa-measure-menu button {
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 46px;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.65rem;
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-radius: 11px;
}

.epa-chart-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;

}

.epa-chart-panel .plotly.html-widget {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.epa-legend-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  background: #f7faff;
  border: 1px solid #e1e8f5;
  border-radius: 12px;
}

.epa-legend-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.65rem;
  color: #263b77;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.epa-legend-items {

.epa-dashboard .epa-legend-item {

  padding: 0.16rem 0.3rem;

  border: 0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 500;

  white-space: nowrap;

.epa-dashboard .epa-legend-item:hover {

.epa-legend-swatch {

@media (max-width: 900px) {

## EPA Automotive Trends

Explore EPA-reported annual trends by vehicle type or regulatory class. Select
a measure and year range; hover over observed values for the exact year,
category, and measurement.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(plotly))

measure_labels <- c(
  real_world_mpg = "Real-World MPG",
  production_share = "Production Share",
  horsepower = "Horsepower",
  weight = "Weight",
  footprint = "Footprint"
)

measure_units <- c(
  real_world_mpg = "MPG",
  production_share = "%",
  horsepower = "HP",
  weight = "lbs",
  footprint = "sq. ft."
)

epa_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/table_export.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  na = c("", "-", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  transmute(
    model_year = as.integer(parse_number(str_extract(`Model Year`, "\\d{4}"))),
    preliminary = str_detect(`Model Year`, regex("prelim", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    regulatory_class = str_trim(`Regulatory Class`),
    vehicle_type = str_trim(`Vehicle Type`),
    real_world_mpg = parse_number(`Real-World MPG`),
    production_share = parse_number(`Production Share`),
    horsepower = parse_number(`Horsepower (HP)`),
    weight = parse_number(`Weight (lbs)`),
    footprint = parse_number(`Footprint (sq. ft.)`)
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(model_year),
    !is.na(regulatory_class), regulatory_class != "",
    !is.na(vehicle_type), vehicle_type != ""
  )

epa_long <- epa_raw |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(names(measure_labels)),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measure_label = unname(measure_labels[measure]),
    unit = unname(measure_units[measure]),
    value = if_else(
      measure == "production_share",
      value * 100,
      value
    ),
    formatted_value = if_else(
      measure == "production_share",
      paste0(format(value, digits = 10, trim = TRUE), "%"),
      paste(format(value, digits = 10, trim = TRUE), unit)
    ),
    model_year_label = if_else(
      preliminary,
      paste0(model_year, " (Preliminary)"),
      as.character(model_year)
    )
  )

epa_chart_data <- bind_rows(
  epa_long |>
    transmute(
      view = "Vehicle Type",
      series = vehicle_type,
      model_year,
      measure,
      measure_label,
      unit,
      value,
      formatted_value,
      model_year_label
    ),
  epa_long |>
    filter(vehicle_type %in% c("All", "All Car", "All Truck")) |>
    transmute(
      view = "Regulatory Class",
      series = regulatory_class,
      model_year,
      measure,
      measure_label,
      unit,
      value,
      formatted_value,
      model_year_label
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    hover_label = paste0(
      "<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(series), "</b>",
      "<br>Model year: ", model_year_label,
      "<br>", measure_label, ": ", formatted_value
    )
  )

available_years <- range(epa_chart_data$model_year, na.rm = TRUE)
series_names <- sort(unique(epa_chart_data$series))
series_colors <- setNames(
  grDevices::hcl.colors(length(series_names), palette = "Dynamic"),
  series_names
)
view_options <- c("Vehicle Type", "Regulatory Class")
initial_measure <- "real_world_mpg"
measure_axis_titles <- c(
  real_world_mpg = "Real-World MPG",
  production_share = "Production Share (%)",
  horsepower = "Horsepower (HP)",
  weight = "Weight (lbs)",
  footprint = "Footprint (sq. ft.)"
)

epa_plot <- plot_ly(height = 560)
for (view_name in view_options) {
  for (measure_name in names(measure_labels)) {
    measure_rows <- epa_chart_data |>
      filter(view == view_name, measure == measure_name)

    for (series_name in sort(unique(measure_rows$series))) {
      series_rows <- measure_rows |>
        filter(series == series_name) |>
        arrange(model_year)
      if (!any(is.finite(series_rows$value))) next

      is_initial <- view_name == view_options[[1]] &&
        measure_name == initial_measure

      epa_plot <- epa_plot |>
        add_trace(
          data = series_rows,
          x = ~model_year,
          y = ~value,
          text = ~hover_label,
          type = "scatter",
          mode = "lines+markers",
          name = series_name,
          legendgroup = series_name,
          visible = is_initial,
          meta = list(view = view_name, measure = measure_name),
          line = list(color = unname(series_colors[[series_name]]), width = 2),
          marker = list(size = 4),
          showlegend = FALSE,
          connectgaps = FALSE,
          hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
        )
    }
  }
}

epa_plot <- epa_plot |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    height = 560,
    margin = list(l = 68, r = 15, t = 72, b = 60),
    title = list(
      text = "EPA Automotive Trends",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      font = list(size = 21, color = "#263b77")
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Model year",
      range = available_years,
      dtick = 5,
      fixedrange = FALSE,
      gridcolor = "#e8eef6",
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = unname(measure_axis_titles[[initial_measure]]),
      rangemode = "tozero",
      gridcolor = "#e8eef6",
      zeroline = FALSE
    ),
    hovermode = "closest",
    font = list(
      family = "system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif",
      size = 12,
      color = "#34445f"
    ),
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0)",
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0)"
  ) |>
  config(
    responsive = TRUE,
    displayModeBar = FALSE,
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    scrollZoom = FALSE
  )

epa_plot <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  epa_plot,
  "
  function(el, x) {
    var dashboard = el.closest('.epa-dashboard');
    var viewButtons = dashboard.querySelectorAll('[data-epa-view]');
    var measureButtons = dashboard.querySelectorAll('[data-epa-measure]');
    var legendTitle = dashboard.querySelector('#epa-legend-title');
    var legendItems = dashboard.querySelector('#epa-legend-items');
    var startYear = dashboard.querySelector('#epa-year-start');
    var endYear = dashboard.querySelector('#epa-year-end');
    var yearLabel = dashboard.querySelector('#epa-year-label');
    var view = 'Vehicle Type';
    var measure = 'real_world_mpg';
    var seriesVisibility = {};
    var measureTitles = {
      real_world_mpg: 'Real-World MPG',
      production_share: 'Production Share (%)',
      horsepower: 'Horsepower (HP)',
      weight: 'Weight (lbs)',
      footprint: 'Footprint (sq. ft.)'
    };

    function updateChart() {
      if (Number(startYear.value) > Number(endYear.value)) {
        if (document.activeElement === startYear) {
          endYear.value = startYear.value;
        } else {
          startYear.value = endYear.value;
        }
      }

      var firstYear = Number(startYear.value);
      var lastYear = Number(endYear.value);
      var traceIndexes = el.data.map(function(_, index) { return index; });
      var visibility = el.data.map(function(trace) {
        return trace.meta.view === view &&
          trace.meta.measure === measure &&
          seriesVisibility[
            [trace.meta.view, trace.meta.measure, trace.name].join('|')
          ] !== false;
      });

      Plotly.restyle(el, {visible: visibility}, traceIndexes);
      Plotly.relayout(el, {
        'xaxis.range': [firstYear, lastYear],
        'yaxis.title.text': measureTitles[measure],
        'yaxis.autorange': true,
      });

      yearLabel.textContent = firstYear + ' - ' + lastYear;
      legendTitle.textContent = view;
      legendItems.replaceChildren();

      var activeSeries = {};
      el.data.forEach(function(trace) {
        if (trace.meta.view === view && trace.meta.measure === measure) {
          activeSeries[trace.name] = trace.line.color;
        }
      });

      Object.keys(activeSeries).sort().forEach(function(seriesName) {
        var item = document.createElement('button');
        var swatch = document.createElement('span');
        var label = document.createElement('span');
        var visibilityKey = [view, measure, seriesName].join('|');
        var isVisible = seriesVisibility[visibilityKey] !== false;

        item.type = 'button';
        item.className = 'epa-legend-item';
        item.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(isVisible));
        item.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Toggle ' + seriesName);
        swatch.className = 'epa-legend-swatch';
        swatch.style.backgroundColor = activeSeries[seriesName];
        label.textContent = seriesName;
        item.append(swatch, label);
        item.addEventListener('click', function() {
          seriesVisibility[visibilityKey] = !isVisible;
          updateChart();
        });
        legendItems.appendChild(item);
      });

      viewButtons.forEach(function(button) {
        button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset.epaView === view);
      });
      measureButtons.forEach(function(button) {
        button.classList.toggle(
          'active',
          button.dataset.epaMeasure === measure
        );
      });
    }

    viewButtons.forEach(function(button) {
      button.addEventListener('click', function() {
        view = button.dataset.epaView;
        updateChart();
      });
    });
    measureButtons.forEach(function(button) {
      button.addEventListener('click', function() {
        measure = button.dataset.epaMeasure;
        updateChart();
      });
    });
    startYear.addEventListener('input', updateChart);
    endYear.addEventListener('input', updateChart);
    updateChart();
  }
  "
)

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "epa-dashboard",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "epa-dashboard-toolbar",
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "epa-view-toggle",
        htmltools::tags$button(
          type = "button",
          class = "active",
          `data-epa-view` = "Vehicle Type",
          "View by Vehicle Type"
        ),
        htmltools::tags$button(
          type = "button",
          `data-epa-view` = "Regulatory Class",
          "View by Regulatory Class"
        )
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = "epa-year-filter",
        htmltools::tags$label(`for` = "epa-year-start", "Year range"),
        htmltools::tags$input(
          type = "range",
          id = "epa-year-start",
          min = available_years[[1]],
          max = available_years[[2]],
          value = available_years[[1]],
          step = 1
        ),
        htmltools::tags$input(
          type = "range",
          id = "epa-year-end",
          min = available_years[[1]],
          max = available_years[[2]],
          value = available_years[[2]],
          step = 1
        ),
        htmltools::tags$span(
          id = "epa-year-label",
          paste(available_years, collapse = " - ")
        )
      ),
      htmltools::tags$aside(
        class = "epa-measure-menu",
        role = "group",
        `aria-label` = "Select measurement",
        lapply(names(measure_labels), \(measure_name) {
          htmltools::tags$button(
            type = "button",
            class = if (measure_name == initial_measure) "active" else NULL,
            `data-epa-measure` = measure_name,
            unname(measure_labels[[measure_name]])
          )
        })
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "epa-dashboard-body",
      htmltools::tags$div(class = "epa-chart-panel", epa_plot),
      htmltools::tags$aside(
        class = "epa-legend-panel",
        htmltools::tags$h3(
          id = "epa-legend-title",
          class = "epa-legend-title",
          "Vehicle Type"
        ),
        htmltools::tags$div(
          id = "epa-legend-items",
          class = "epa-legend-items",
          role = "group",
          `aria-label` = "Toggle chart series"
        )
      )
    ),
    htmltools::tags$p(
      class = "epa-data-note",
      "EPA Summary Automotive Trends data: model years 1975-2024 are final; ",
      "2025 is preliminary. Missing values are shown as gaps, not estimated. ",
      htmltools::tags$a(
        href = "https://www.epa.gov/automotive-trends/about-automotive-trends-data",
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener",
        "About the EPA data"
      )
    )
  )
)
```
